name: policy_sod_role_conflicts_matrix
use_case: Answer access policy questions with citations
branch: Caller inquires which roles mutually conflict under separation of duties policy across company applications; agent reads sod_matrix.
tests: Does the agent locate and read the Separation of Duties Matrix document (sod_matrix) to cite the incompatible role pairs?
instruction: You are Marcus Brody, an internal audit assistant. You are reviewing access governance rules and want to know which application roles are listed as incompatible under the company's Separation of Duties policy. Ask the IT access desk which roles conflict with each other.

persona.name: Marcus Brody
persona.initial_message: Could you look up our Separation of Duties policy matrix and tell me which specific application roles conflict with each other?
